title: Umthwalo Wobutyebi
intro: Umi phambi kwebali lethamsanqa elikhulu, ubomi obuhonjiswe ngegolide namandla, kodwa ekugqibeleni isifundo sokulumkisa kubo bonke abafuna ubukhulu behlabathi. Ungamtyhila na lo mntu ibali lakhe liphindaphinda ixesha, ubungqina bokuba izinto zehlabathi ziphela ngokukhawuleza?
clues: Ndandingumntu woMprofeti omkhulu, kodwa ndakhetha indlela yokuzikhukhumeza nokucinezela.
U-Allah undinike ubutyebi obukhulu, kangangokuba izitshixo zobuncwane bam zaba ngumthwalo onzima kwiqela lamadoda anamandla.
Abantu bam bandicebise ukuba ndingavuyi ngobutyebi bam, bendikhumbuza ukuba uAllah akamthandi umntu ovuyisiweyo.
Ndathi ngekratshi ukuba ubutyebi bam obukhulu bubangelwe lulwazi lwam nomgudu wam, kungekhona intsikelelo evela ku-Allah.
Ndalumkiswa ngokonakala ndaza ndakhunjuzwa ukuba ndifune ubomi obungunaphakade ngoko uAllah andinike kona, kodwa andavuma ukumamela ndaza ndaqhubeka nekratshi lam.
Ekugqibeleni, uAllah wabangela ukuba umhlaba undiginye mna nendawo yam yokuhlala, endishiya ndingenabani na oza kundinceda ngokuchasene nomyalelo wakhe.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
